### R

```{r}
#| label: basin-iterates-r
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Plot of the double-well function x to the fourth minus 2 x squared
#|   for x from -1.6 to 1.6, a grey W-shaped curve with minima of -1
#|   at x of -1 and 1 and a local maximum of 0 at x of 0.
#|   Points mark the gradient descent iterates from six starting values,
#|   three positive and three negative.
#|   Positive starts, drawn as blue circles, slide down the right well to 1.
#|   Negative starts, drawn as orange triangles,
#|   slide down the left well to -1.
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 5
library(ggplot2)
basin_cost_bf <- function(x) x^4 - 2 * x^2
basin_paths_bf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(basin_starts_bs[1:6], function(x0) {
  x <- Reduce(function(x, i) basin_next_bs(x), 1:30, x0, accumulate = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    x = x,
    cost = basin_cost_bf(x),
    side = ifelse(x0 > 0, "start above 0", "start below 0")
  )
}))
ggplot(basin_paths_bf, aes(x, cost)) +
  geom_function(fun = basin_cost_bf, colour = "grey60", xlim = c(-1.6, 1.6)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = side, shape = side), alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("start above 0" = "#0072B2", "start below 0" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(x = "x", y = "f(x)", colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: basin-iterates-python
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Plot of the double-well function x to the fourth minus 2 x squared
#|   for x from -1.6 to 1.6, a grey W-shaped curve with minima of -1
#|   at x of -1 and 1 and a local maximum of 0 at x of 0.
#|   Points mark the gradient descent iterates from six starting values,
#|   three positive and three negative.
#|   Positive starts, drawn as blue circles, slide down the right well to 1.
#|   Negative starts, drawn as orange triangles,
#|   slide down the left well to -1.
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 5
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def basin_cost_bf(x):
    return x ** 4 - 2 * x ** 2

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 4), layout="constrained")
grid_bf = np.linspace(-1.6, 1.6, 321)
ax.plot(grid_bf, basin_cost_bf(grid_bf), color="grey")
for start in basin_starts_bs[:6]:
    x = [start]
    for _ in range(30):
        x.append(basin_next_bs(x[-1]))
    x = np.array(x)
    above = start > 0
    ax.plot(x, basin_cost_bf(x), linestyle="", alpha=0.7,
            color="#0072B2" if above else "#D55E00",
            marker="o" if above else "^",
            label=("start above 0" if above else "start below 0")
            if abs(start) == 0.1 else None)
ax.set_xlabel("x")
ax.set_ylabel("f(x)")
fig.legend(loc="outside lower center", ncol=2)
plt.show()
```

:::

[Gradient descent](#def-gradient-descent) with step length $`r basin_step_bs`$
on the double-well function of @exm-basin-of-attraction,
from six starting values.
Each run settles at the [local minimizer](algebra-basics.qmd#def-local-minimizer)
on its own side of the [local maximizer](#def-local-maximizer) at $0$.

:::
